57: What is different regarding the first clause and what is different with the latter clause - He [the owner] sees that they are [directly] touching [the pure produce] as it teaches they [the ignorant workers] were loading the pure produce and this case is not discussing barrels that would have been sealed.
Where he purified is donkey drivers - He made them [have a ritual] dip, and therefore their touching [pure items] leaves them pure.
